t: Static Application Security Tester - public implementations survey
title: Static Application Security Tester - public implementations survey
definition: Scans source code for potential security defects.
description:
This database surveys Static Application Security Tester as it exists in public practice: Scans source code for potential security defects. The records below name real tools with real track records, explain the techniques they are built on, cite the standards they implement, and provide drills that build working skill. Nothing here is speculative - every implementation is a real project you can download, every technique is established practice.

The value of a survey like this is comparative: seeing seven real implementations side by side reveals what the capability truly requires and where each tool draws its boundaries. The technique records go deeper, explaining the machinery - the algorithms, protocols and disciplines - that make Static Application Security Tester work regardless of which tool you pick.

Use this database as a field guide. When a build calls for Static Application Security Tester, consult the spotlights to choose an implementation, check the standards to stay interoperable, and run the drills to build fluency. Each record's demo program runs with node - the capability is demonstrated end to end.
